name: Playwright Test Automation
certifications: No official Playwright certification; assessed by capstone projects
ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE)
tools: VS Code with the Playwright extension

beginner.summary: For manual testers, Selenium users and developers starting browser automation with Playwright. Covers installing Playwright, TypeScript for testers, the Playwright Test runner, role-based locators, actions, web-first assertions and auto-waiting, hooks and tags, codegen, UI mode and the trace viewer, frames and popups, page objects, fixtures, saved login state, API tests, network mocking, cross-browser projects, reports and running tests in CI.
prerequisites: Knows how to test a web application by hand
Can use a terminal and install Node.js
outcomes: Write reliable Playwright tests with role-based locators and web-first assertions
Organise tests with page objects, fixtures and saved login state
Mock network calls and test APIs with Playwright
Run tests across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit in CI with reports and traces
